build_online_rollout_batch: build an online rollout batch by generating completions from prompts and scoring them with reward functions
generate_text_with_vllm: generate text completions from prompts using vLLM with weight syncing and prompt deduplication
generate_text_with_transformers: generate text completions from left-padded prompts using HuggingFace Transformers with EOS masking
calculate_reward_scores: calculate reward scores for generated completions using neural reward models or custom reward functions
compute_policy_loss: compute the SDPO policy loss using clipped importance sampling with grouped advantages
record_reward_diagnostics: record reward diagnostics including mean, std, min, max, and flat-group detection warnings
summarize_online_rollout_mixin: summarize the OnlineRolloutMixin class that provides generation, reward scoring, and policy-loss utilities for self-distillation trainers
